_readme: Accessibility baseline for the axe (WCAG 2.1 AA) e2e gate in a11y.spec.ts. The gate scans the whole page — nothing is excluded — and tolerates a violation only when its node sits inside one of the @dhis2/ui components listed below, matched by axe rule id plus that component's own data-test selector. Anchoring on the component rather than on a page region or an individual element is deliberate: adding a nav entry or another shell element does not turn the gate red for a defect the vendor already owns, yet every other rule on those components, and every rule on the app's own markup wherever it sits, still fails. Add an entry only for a defect that is genuinely unfixable from the app, quote the vendor source that causes it, and re-check the list on each @dhis2/ui upgrade.

ignored.note: @dhis2/ui <Menu> renders <ul role="menu"> (menu/menu.js) whose <li> children carry role="presentation" together with a tabindex (menu-item/menu-item.js). A focusable element's presentation role is conflict-resolved back to its implicit role, so the menu's owned children compute as listitem. Structural to the component — it fires for every MenuItem regardless of the props the app passes.
The same @dhis2/ui <Menu> defect seen from the child side: each <a role="menuitem"> sits inside the conflict-resolved <li>, so its parent computes as listitem instead of menu.
@dhis2/ui <HeaderBar> apps-menu toggle (header-bar/apps.js): an icon-only <button> holding just an IconApps24 svg, with no aria-label and no text content.

@dhis2/ui logo link (header-bar/logo.js): wrapping a nameless LogoIconWhite svg. Fires only while the instance has no custom logo banner configured — the custom-logo branch renders an that carries an alt attribute.
